cards.claim: Unterwachingen is a member of Kommunale Informationsverarbeitung Reutlingen-Ulm (KIRU).
cards.quote: Unterwachingen is a member of Kommunale Informationsverarbeitung Reutlingen-Ulm (KIRU), a company that provides information technology services to municipalities in the region. Evidence of this membership can be found on the KIRU website, which lists Unterwachingen as one of its member municipalities. [1] Additionally, the municipality's own website mentions its membership in KIRU, stating that it has been a member since 1992.

raw_card.claim: The municipality of Unterwachingen has officially become a member of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU).
